Hey Everyone!

This .zip file includes both the Wrapper and the Native workflow.

Here is a link to a video tutorial for these workflows if you need it:Tutorial Link

Otherwise all of the directions should be in the workflows themselves!

The workflow uses an SDXL or Flux controlnet first frame generation and controlnet driving video to generate a new video based on the two inputs!
